strings.(뒤에 있는 건물에 대해 물어보자.): (Let's ask about the building behind him.)
This? It's a peculiar building I've been investigating.
strings.이 안으로 들어가면 위쪽, 천장을 향해 연결된 계단이 늘어서 있어. 그리: Inside, there's a stairway leading up toward the ceiling. At the very top stands an enormous stone door that won't open.
strings.단원들의 힘을 모두 동원해 보았지만 결국 그 문을 열지도, 부수지도 못했: Even with every member of the company lending a hand, we couldn't open it or break it down.
strings.밖에서 본 구조대로라면 그 문 뒤는 텅 비었을거야. 피크만이 그렇게 말했: Judging by the building's shape from outside, there should be nothing beyond that door. That's what Pikman said. ...But my gut tells me there's definitely something on the other side.
Ha ha. You look like you don't believe me. That's fine. I'm just doing what I want to do.
strings.너도 한번 들어가서 올라가 보는 건 어때? 특별할 건 없겠지만 위에서 보: Why don't you go inside and climb up yourself? You probably won't find anything special, but the view from up there isn't bad.
strings.(말을 마친 아케인은 낮게 웃었다. …들어가서 위에 한번 올라가 볼까?): (Arcane finishes speaking with a low chuckle. ...Should I go inside and take a look upstairs?)
strings.(낮은 진동과 함께 석문이 덜커덩 거렸다.): (The stone door rattles with a faint tremor.)
strings.(문 건너 편에서 어렴풋이 무슨 소리가 들린 듯 하다.): (A faint sound seems to come from the other side of the door.)
strings.(문을 열 수 있을 것 같다. 일단 들어가볼까?): (It looks like the door will open. Should I go in?)
strings.(응? 그런데 이 작고 날개 달린 금빛 투구를 쓴 익숙한 얼굴은…?!): (Huh? That familiar little face beneath a golden helmet with wings...?!)
strings.(확실히 거친 숨소리에 짐승의 으르렁거림이 섞여 있다.): (There's definitely an animal's growl mixed in with that heavy breathing.)
strings.…인간…인가. 어떻게 들어왔지?: ...A human...? How did you get in?
strings.……늑대 냄새… ……너, 제릴의 냄새가 섞여있다…: ...The scent of a wolf... ...You carry Jeril's scent...
My name is Hawa. I am the master of this Sky Castle.
strings.인간… 너는 뭐냐…? 제릴과 무슨 관련이 있지…?: Human... what are you...? What connection do you have to Jeril...?
strings.그 성질 더럽고 못되처먹은 흰 늑대의 친구라고?!: You're friends with that foul-tempered, rotten white wolf?!
...A friend of Jeril's is an enemy of mine.
strings.흰 늑대를 만났다는 사실조차 후회하게 만들어주지!!!: I'll make you regret ever meeting that white wolf!!!
strings.(하와는 제릴과 그다지 사이가 좋지 않은 것 같다.): (Hawa and Jeril don't seem to get along very well.)
strings.2. 나는 제릴을 이긴 인간이다!: 2. I'm the human who defeated Jeril!
strings.거짓말 마라!!! 성질 더럽고 못되처먹은 흰 늑대지만 그 실력만은 확실하: Don't lie!!! That white wolf may be foul-tempered and rotten, but his strength is beyond question!
strings.제릴이 한낱 인간 따위에게 쓰러질 리 없다!!!: Jeril would never fall to a mere human!!!
strings.그깟 거짓말로 제릴의 명예에 먹칠을 하다니… 용서 못한다. 후회하게 해주: You dare tarnish Jeril's honor with such a lie... I won't forgive you. I'll make you regret it!!!
strings.(도대체 제릴과 사이가 좋은 것인지 나쁜 것인지 알 수가 없다.): (I can't tell whether he likes Jeril or hates him.)
strings.(…이렇게 화를 낼 거면 애초에 제릴 얘기는 왜 물어본거지?): (...If it was going to make him this angry, why did he ask about Jeril in the first place?)
strings.…넌 제법 강하구나 인간. 이름이 뭐지?: ...You're quite strong, human. What is your name?
strings.(문 뒤에서 하와의 목소리가 들려왔다. 하와에게 이름을 알려주었다.): (Hawa's voice comes from behind the door. I tell him my name.)
......You remind me of the humans who once lived here.
They were strong, shining with conviction... There was a mysterious air about them.
strings.인간들은 나만 보면 꺅꺅거리며 시끄럽고 칼을 뽑아대서 난 인간들을 싫어하: I dislike humans. Whenever they see me, they scream and draw their swords. But those humans weren't so bad.
We used to play together often. Sparring...? That's what they called it.
strings.그들이 오지 않게된 게 언제부터였는 지 기억도 나지 않을 정도로 잊고 있: I'd forgotten them so completely that I can't even remember when they stopped coming. But today...
Today, I feel the way I did back then.
strings.(설마 하와가 말하는 인간들이란…): (Could the humans Hawa is talking about be...?)
Come back whenever you like, human. No... %s.
